onsetDefinition: Onset definition v2 (local-relative 5-day accumulation, adapted from Moron & Robertson 2014)
onsetRule: Onset v2: first wet day (≥ 1 mm) in DOY 121–270 whose 5-day rainfall reaches this point's own June–September mean 5-day rainfall over 2001–2025, with no 10-day period under 5 mm in the 30 days after.

crossCheck.source: NASA GPM IMERG V07 daily (0.1°, via NASA POWER)
crossCheck.provider: NASA GSFC / JAXA — GPM mission; daily aggregation by NASA POWER (LaRC)
crossCheck.citation: Huffman et al., GPM IMERG V07 — doi:10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-HH/07

homogeneity: Pettitt change-point test on annual PRECTOTCORR and annual mean T2M_MAX; per pack in quality
